title: The Librarians
description:
S03 E07 — And the Curse of Cindy
Cindy Kroger suddenly becomes popular thanks to a magical love potion; the librarians must stop Cindy before she launches a love missile that would force the entire world to become her fan base.

title: The Librarians
description:

The librarians are led to a holistic spa that is run by vampires when a rash of people spontaneously combust.

description:

Sophie, Eliot and Parker get caught in a small-town speed trap run by a corrupt mayor; they decide to help the oppressed townspeople wrest power from his hungry clutches.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E08 — The Cooling off the Mark Job
Old friend Hurley stumbles into the path of a Mark out for vengeance on the crew; he must take point on one of the most delicate parts of the con the Cool Off; despite the crew's help, the situation spins out of control.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E07 — And the Con-Con
Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E08 — And the Hangover From Hell
After a bachelorette party with Lysa's childhood best friend, the team wakes up in rough shape and hungover, with no idea how they ended up where they are.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S02 E07 — All In
Before the grand opening of Mactan's resort casino owned and operated by the Villegas family, Ann Villegas recruits Alex to test the casino's security system.

title: Almost Paradise

Kai and Alex go undercover as a New Age-y couple at a self-help retreat in order to extract a naïve young woman from the clutches of a dangerous cult.

description:

Parker decides to take down a local factory kingpin using child labor; the villain spins his own version of how he was wrongfully destroyed, the team tries to unravel the con Parker's running; the team must play catch up.

With a new team member on board, plus the arrival of Hardison's genius foster sister, the team heads to Panama to pull an elaborate heist before an evil billionaire can get his money and flee to a non-extradition country.

description:

description:

description:
